Overview

Huancayo is a city in JU with a population of 400,000. The commercial heart of Peru’s central highlands, known for its Sunday fair and Andean traditions. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
